findings.detail: The scene repeats earlier question M2-S52-T1. In both, extraction findings are dismissed as false positives and the team wants to group the dismissals by source content. In both, each finding stores only a field name and a message, and the answer is to record the triggering construct as a detected_pattern. Only the document type (contracts instead of invoices) and the framing (cause instead of change) differ. Option D also reuses the earlier wrong option of retrying with feedback appended to the prompt.
